blockingFindings.description: V80 still shows broad anterior-thigh exposure in sit.png and crouch.png. The side panels lift and terminate in separated, pointed triangular tabs, so continuous front/side coverage fails. Astra independently confirmed the same seated and crouch failures.

left.png and back.png retain dense, narrow accordion ridges along the overskirt sides. Shortening the hem extension by 20 mm and lowering thigh-follow from 0.72 to 0.42 did not remove the side-panel lift or corrugation.

front.png and three-quarter.png continue to show a center-dipping hem with side flare. The V80 weight and hem adjustments do not establish a coherent standing hem. Astra independently requested revised front coverage, side-panel drape, and hem equalization.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
